# MRP — ERP for Thai SME factories

> Multi-tenant SaaS ERP for small and medium factories in Thailand: material requirements planning (MRP),
> lot-based inventory with FIFO/FEFO picking, purchasing with configurable approval steps, multi-level
> bills of materials and work orders. Thai-first UI, English available.

## What it does today

- MRP that nets usable stock (lots waiting for QC are excluded), adds open purchase orders and work orders,
  applies safety stock, lead time and lot sizing, and proposes purchase requests and work orders that can be
  created with one click. A second run does not propose the same items again.
- Inventory as an append-only ledger: every movement is a new entry, voids are reversals, balances are
  derived from the ledger. Lots carry supplier lot, manufacturing and expiry dates and QC status.
- Purchasing: purchase requests, purchase orders with tiered supplier prices, receiving against PO with an
  over-receipt tolerance, returns to supplier.
- Approval engine: steps per document type, amount thresholds, mandatory two-factor sign-in for a step,
  mobile approval; requesters cannot approve their own documents.
- Multi-level BOM with versions (one active per item), explosion with shortages, where-used.
- Standard cost roll-up from the BOM (loss at every level plus an overhead percentage) compared with the
  sales price: gross margin per unit and in percent, before quoting.
- Finite-capacity machine scheduling: routings (operations with setup and run time per unit), machines in
  groups, working shifts and holidays per tenant; work orders are placed child-before-parent and by due
  date, each operation after the previous one, late orders flagged; slots can be locked.
- Security: one database, every table carries tenant_id and PostgreSQL Row-Level Security is enforced;
  the API connects with a role that cannot bypass it.

## In development

Shop-floor data entry through LINE and QR codes; Excel import; jobs for contract manufacturers with
subcontracting and profit per job; connectors for Express, PEAK and FlowAccount; asking the system
questions through LINE with AI.

## Packages (launch pricing, THB per month)

- Starter 2,900: purchasing and inventory, 5 users
- Pro 6,900: plus BOM, MRP and work orders, 15 users
- Enterprise 15,000: plus sales, invoicing, accounting links, API, dedicated database
